scope: Extend modeler SAT text whole-operation allocation rollback/retry coverage to Binary DXF alongside ASCII for a generated AC1024 3DSOLID profile.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DXF modeler record
source.profile: One AC1024 E3DSOLID with 600 generated text bytes in three ordered group-1/3 chunks (255, 255, and 90 bytes), written in ASCII and Binary DXF. The text is a transport stress payload and is not asserted to be valid ACIS geometry. No external drawing fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Extend the focused generated modeler write failure sweep to both writer encodings. Warm each encoding, measure its allocation offsets, inject failure at every offset and require destination/caller/identity rollback plus staging cleanup. Retry the same codec and require clean-byte identity and fresh typed fileImport readback of the chunk sequence.

validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 102 and Binary 101 whole-write allocation offsets injected; rollback, staging cleanup, same-codec retry and typed import readback passed in both encodings.

limitations: The generated payload is not parsed or validated as ACIS syntax and provides no geometry semantics.
Only the AC1024 text carrier is covered; producer interoperability and other modeler carriers or target versions remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue P6-G's inventory with another exact missing variable-size writer or uncovered whole-operation caller-state route.
